text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...The "results" are in. However, there 
are still many issues to address looking 
ahead to the Japan Derby.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even though Kris S-san ran so 
magnificently, she isn't happy at all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now, I can't be like that. I 
can't look toward what's next... look 
forward so straightforwardly—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Guhh! Symboli Kris S runs so strong~! 
Though seriously, what's with that 
unfriendly attitude of hers~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The Derby's gonna be exciting! ...Still, 
that aloof attitude is kinda bothering me. 
...She doesn't look down on Japanese 
races, does she?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. A fragment of my soul whispers to 
me. Does your destiny... lie in "Autumn"?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that matters not to you, does it? 
You close the distance with unyielding 
strides. Defying fate, in order to fulfill 
your "mission"...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...It is almost time, Kris S. In "this" 
world where we breathe, let us engrave 
ourselves upon it to our heart's content—

Symboli Kris S successfully delivered 
results. She must surely be fatigued, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Areas of improvement. Today's race—has 
many areas—that need work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Once we return... to the academy... I want 
to... deal with it... right away.

Her sights are already set on the next 
goal: the Japanese Derby. Her ability to 
switch gears is truly that of a consummate 
professional.
choice_data_list: OK, meeting as soon as we get back!

OK, we'll hold a meeting as soon as we get 
back!

text_block_list.text:
There is little time left before the 
decisive Nippon Derby. Together with 
Symboli Kris S, we pressed forward without 
looking aside.
